description: Supply technology that supports storage co-located with wind and solar generation. Capital costs, operating costs, capacity limits, and lifetimes are carried separately for the solar, wind, storage, and inverter portions, which share one grid connection.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`).

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type to be used in PCM modeling.

region.description: Location where the component applies. Can be a zone or node.

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology.

capital_costs_solar.description: Capital and interconnection cost for investing in a solar technology (capital cost in USD/MW).

operation_costs_solar.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for the solar component. Units: USD/MWh.

capacity_limits_solar.description: Maximum allowable installed capacity for the solar component. Units: MW.

lifetime_solar.description: Maximum number of years the solar component can be active once installed. Units: yr.

capital_costs_wind.description: Capital and interconnection cost for investing in a wind technology (capital cost in USD/MW).

operation_costs_wind.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for the wind component. Units: USD/MWh.

capacity_limits_wind.description: Maximum allowable installed capacity for the wind component. Units: MW.

lifetime_wind.description: Maximum number of years the wind component can be active once installed. Units: yr.

capital_costs_energy.description: Capital costs for investing in the storage technology's energy capacity. Units: USD/MWh.

capital_costs_power.description: Capital costs for investing in the storage technology's charge/discharge capacity. Units: USD/MW.

operation_costs_energy.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for the storage energy component. Units: USD/MWh.

operation_costs_power.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for the storage power component. Units: USD/MWh.

capacity_power_limits.description: Allowable installed power capacity for the storage component. Units: MW.

capacity_energy_limits.description: Allowable installed energy capacity for the storage component. Units: MWh.

duration_limits.description: Minimum and maximum duration limits for the storage component (minutes). Units: min.

efficiency_storage.description: Efficiency of charging storage, fraction of total charge (in) and discharge (out) capacity. Units: 1.

losses_storage.description: Self-discharge of storage (fraction of stored energy per hour). Units: 1.

lifetime_storage.description: Maximum number of years the storage component can be active once installed. Units: yr.

max_inverter_capacity.description: Limit on inverter capacity. Units: MW.

capital_costs_inverter.description: Capital and interconnection cost for investing in inverter capacity (capital cost in USD/MW).

operation_costs_inverter.description: Operational costs for using inverter in co-located systems. Units: USD/MWh.

inverter_efficiency.description: Efficiency of AC to DC conversion of inverter. Units: 1.

inverter_supply_ratio.description: Ratio of generation capacity to grid connection capacity. Units: 1.

requirements.description: List of requirement IDs associated with the component.

title: ColocatedSupplyStorageTechnology
